title: オークスの後に・天使？

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I gave the race everything I had, and in the end, I got the win!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But… my fans said I was scary… Instead of being happy for me, they were disappointed I didn't look like the cute Snow Angel they thought I was.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: It was probably because I didn't win in style. If I give a super awesome performance in my next race, I'm sure I'll be the apple of their eyes again!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: So before the Shuka Sho, I'm gonna run in the Queen Stakes… Go ahead and get your hopes up for that one!
